packageRules.description: The supported Python floor is a project decision, not a dependency. Renovate reads it from .python-version, setup-python pins in the workflows, and the python Docker tag; all three must be disabled or it will keep trying to drag the project to the newest interpreter (see #915).
Group non-major updates into a single PR and merge on green CI.
Majors get one PR each, but still merge themselves once CI is green.
textual and its satellites are pinned to exact, version-coupled releases; upgrade them together by hand. Listed last so it overrides the automerge rules above.
